lines.zh: 我沿着树干往上爬，六足抓着树皮。
lines.en: I climb the trunk, six feet gripping the bark.

lines.zh: 我的身体太软，走路像挪动水袋。
lines.en: My body is so soft that walking feels like moving a water skin.

lines.zh: 我在枝叶间挤过去，叶上留下黏液。
lines.en: I squeeze through the branches, leaving slime on the leaves.

lines.zh: 每走一步，背上就渗出一点甜水。
lines.en: Each step oozes a little sweet water from my back.

lines.zh: 我从这片叶子走到那片叶子。
lines.en: I go from this leaf to the next one.

lines.zh: 树干很粗，我走得比看起来快。
lines.en: The trunk is thick, and I am faster than I look.

lines.zh: 我一动，整丛叶子都跟着晃。
lines.en: When I move, the whole clump of leaves shakes.

lines.zh: 我的足尖勾住叶脉，稳稳的。
lines.en: My feet hook the veins and hold firm.

lines.zh: 我在林间慢慢挪，影子盖住草。
lines.en: I creep through the wood, my shadow flattening the grass.

lines.zh: 走着走着，身后的叶子发亮了。
lines.en: As I walk, the leaves behind me begin to shine.

lines.zh: 我绕过树瘤，肚子擦过它。
lines.en: I go around a burl, my belly brushing it.

lines.zh: 这具身体太大，走路很费劲。
lines.en: This body is too big, and walking costs me.

lines.zh: 我往下爬，头朝着地面。
lines.en: I climb down headfirst toward the ground.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，边走边吸树汁。
lines.en: I stop at every step to drink sap.

lines.zh: 我压弯一根细枝，再挪到下一根。
lines.en: I bend a thin branch, then shift to the next.

lines.zh: 我慢吞吞爬过苔藓，留下一道湿线。
lines.en: I crawl over moss, leaving a wet line.

lines.zh: 我把口器插进树皮，慢慢吸。
lines.en: I sink my mouthparts into the bark and drink slowly.

lines.zh: 我趴在叶背，一动不动。
lines.en: I lie under a leaf without moving.

lines.zh: 甜水从我身后滴到草上。
lines.en: Sweet water drips from my rear onto the grass.

lines.zh: 我鼓着身子，谁靠近都不理。
lines.en: I swell up and ignore anyone who comes near.

lines.zh: 森林里到处都是我能吃的东西。
lines.en: The forest is full of things I can eat.

lines.zh: 我的足慢慢换着位置，怕掉下去。
lines.en: My feet shift slowly so I do not fall.

lines.zh: 吸饱了，我就撑得走不动。
lines.en: When I am full I am too bloated to walk.

lines.zh: 蚂蚁在下面等着我的甜水。
lines.en: Ants wait below for my sweet water.

lines.zh: 我听见树叶响，那只是风。
lines.en: I hear leaves rustle, but it is only wind.

lines.zh: 我的身体一缩一胀，像在呼吸。
lines.en: My body swells and shrinks as if breathing.

lines.zh: 我在这里已经待了半天。
lines.en: I have been in this spot half a day.

lines.zh: 树汁流得慢，我的耐心很长。
lines.en: Sap flows slowly, and my patience is long.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上抬起软软的头。
lines.en: I lift my soft head from the leaf.

lines.zh: 你站在树下，我把身子转过来。
lines.en: You stand below the tree, and I turn toward you.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里有几百个你。
lines.en: My compound eyes hold a few hundred of you.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到叶边，往下看。
lines.en: I creep to the leaf edge and look down.

lines.zh: 你伸手过来，我的足都缩了一下。
lines.en: Your hand comes near and all my feet pull in.

lines.zh: 我不怕你，只是不想掉下去。
lines.en: I am not afraid of you, only of falling.

lines.zh: 我的须动了动，闻到你身上的味道。
lines.en: My antennae twitch, catching your smell.

lines.zh: 你比树皮好看一些。
lines.en: You are a little nicer to look at than bark.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，嘴里还在吸树汁。
lines.en: I watch you while still drinking sap.

lines.zh: 我歪了歪身子，把你看全。
lines.en: I lean sideways to take all of you in.

lines.zh: 我的软身被划开，汁水淌下来。
lines.en: My soft body is cut open and juice runs out.

lines.zh: 我被砍得缩成一团，紧紧贴地。
lines.en: The blow makes me bunch up flat against the ground.

lines.zh: 疼得我六只足都乱了。
lines.en: The pain tangles all six of my legs.

lines.zh: 这一刀切开皮，里面全是绿的。
lines.en: The blade opens me, all green inside.

lines.zh: 我掉在原地，慢慢才动。
lines.en: I drop where I am and move only slowly.

lines.zh: 甜水和血混在一起，很黏。
lines.en: Sweet water and blood mix into something sticky.

lines.zh: 我想爬走，可身体不听话。
lines.en: I want to crawl away, but my body refuses.

lines.zh: 你把我打扁一半，我还活着。
lines.en: You flatten half of me and I am still alive.

lines.zh: 我的须断了一根，摆得很奇怪。
lines.en: One antenna is broken and hangs oddly.

lines.zh: 我发出很轻的摩擦声。
lines.en: I make a very faint rasping sound.

lines.zh: 你把带汁的叶子递来，我立刻伸口器。
lines.en: You offer a sappy leaf and my mouthparts extend at once.

lines.zh: 甜味一进空气，我就挪不动了。
lines.en: Once sweetness is in the air, I cannot move elsewhere.

lines.zh: 那片叶子还在滴，我看见了。
lines.en: That leaf is still dripping, and I have seen it.

lines.zh: 我朝你的手爬，六足并得很快。
lines.en: I crawl for your hand, all six feet hurrying.

lines.zh: 我不吃别的，只喝树里的东西。
lines.en: I eat nothing else; only what the tree carries.

lines.zh: 你把叶子放低，我就从树上下来。
lines.en: Lower the leaf and I will come down.

lines.zh: 汁水沾在你手上，我也舔。
lines.en: Sap sticks to your fingers, and I lick that too.

lines.zh: 我围着那片叶子转了一圈才下口。
lines.en: I circle the leaf once before biting in.

lines.zh: 甜的东西让我胆子变大。
lines.en: Sweetness makes me bolder.

lines.zh: 吃饱之后，我连爬都懒得爬。
lines.en: Once fed, I cannot be bothered to crawl.

lines.zh: 你撞到树干，我从叶上滑了半尺。
lines.en: You jolt the trunk and I slide half a foot.

lines.zh: 我的软身被挤扁，又慢慢鼓回来。
lines.en: My soft body squashes flat and swells back.

lines.zh: 你踩过草丛，把我从叶背震下来。
lines.en: You tramp through the grass and shake me off the leaf.

lines.zh: 我撞在树皮上，沾了一片绿。
lines.en: I hit the bark and smear it green.

lines.zh: 相撞时我什么也没做，只是收缩。
lines.en: On impact I do nothing but contract.

lines.zh: 你的肩擦过叶丛，我顺着叶子滑开。
lines.en: Your shoulder brushes the leaves and I slide aside.

lines.zh: 我被顶着走了一段，足还抓着叶。
lines.en: I am pushed along a while, feet still hooked.

lines.zh: 我掉在土上，翻过来才站稳。
lines.en: I land in the dirt and need to right myself.

lines.zh: 你挡在我和叶脉之间，我绕过去。
lines.en: You come between me and the veins; I go around.

lines.zh: 这一碰让我把甜水挤了出来。
lines.en: The knock squeezes sweet water out of me.

lines.zh: 我们两三只挤在同一片叶下。
lines.en: Two or three of us crowd under a single leaf.

lines.zh: 我用须碰它，它就跟着动。
lines.en: I touch it with an antenna and it follows.

lines.zh: 森林里这样的相遇很常见。
lines.en: Encounters like this are common in the forest.

lines.zh: 我们贴在一起，谁也不吸汁。
lines.en: We press together and neither of us feeds.

lines.zh: 它的身子比我鼓，颜色更深。
lines.en: Its body is rounder than mine and darker.

lines.zh: 我绕着它爬了半圈。
lines.en: I crawl halfway around it.

lines.zh: 交配对我们来说只是挨着不动。
lines.en: For us, mating is only lying still together.

lines.zh: 之后我们各自爬向不同的叶子。
lines.en: Afterward we crawl to separate leaves.

lines.zh: 甜水在我们之间流下来。
lines.en: Sweet water runs down between us.

lines.zh: 叶子上留下我们挤出的汁。
lines.en: The leaf keeps the juice we squeezed out.

lines.zh: 我用前足抱住那片掉下的叶子。
lines.en: I hug the fallen leaf with my forelegs.

lines.zh: 地上有甜块，我慢慢爬过去。
lines.en: There is a sweet lump on the ground; I crawl to it.

lines.zh: 太大块的东西我抱不动。
lines.en: Anything too large I cannot carry.

lines.zh: 我把它贴在口器上，边走边吸。
lines.en: I press it to my mouthparts and feed while walking.

lines.zh: 掉下来的果子，我也尝一口。
lines.en: A fallen fruit gets a taste from me.

lines.zh: 这块东西黏在我足上，甩不掉。
lines.en: This lump sticks to my foot and will not shake off.

lines.zh: 我把叶子拖到叶背下面。
lines.en: I drag the leaf under another leaf.

lines.zh: 亮亮的东西，我不感兴趣。
lines.en: Shiny things do not interest me.

lines.zh: 我抱着它，六足走得很别扭。
lines.en: Carrying it, my six feet move awkwardly.

lines.zh: 掉下来的都归我，慢慢吃。
lines.en: Whatever falls is mine, and I eat it slowly.

lines.zh: 你折断树枝，我朝那边转了身。
lines.en: You snap a branch and I turn that way.

lines.zh: 你靠得太近，我抬起头。
lines.en: You come too close, and I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我从不主动，可你惹到我了。
lines.en: I never start things, but you have annoyed me.

lines.zh: 我的身子鼓起来，这是警告。
lines.en: I swell up, and that is a warning.

lines.zh: 你踩坏叶子，我就往你身上爬。
lines.en: You crush the leaves, so I crawl toward you.

lines.zh: 我盯上你那只乱动的手。
lines.en: I fix on that restless hand of yours.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪到叶边，准备下去。
lines.en: I creep to the leaf edge, ready to drop.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道让我不安。
lines.en: Your smell makes me uneasy.

lines.zh: 我从树上滑下来，朝你走。
lines.en: I slide down the trunk and come at you.

lines.zh: 六只足一起用力，我冲了过去。
lines.en: All six feet push and I rush forward.

lines.zh: 你打我，我就认定你是敌人。
lines.en: You hit me, so I count you as an enemy.

lines.zh: 我爬到你脚上，你才发觉。
lines.en: I climb onto your foot before you notice.

lines.zh: 这片林子不许你继续走。
lines.en: This wood will not let you go further.

lines.zh: 我把身子低下去，像块石头。
lines.en: I flatten myself like a stone.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的气味爬，很慢但很直。
lines.en: I crawl along your scent, slow but straight.

lines.zh: 你换了位置，我转了个弯。
lines.en: You move, and I bend my course.

lines.zh: 我在草丛里，比你矮得多。
lines.en: In the grass I am far lower than you.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，我的足没有声音。
lines.en: You cannot hear me; my feet make no sound.

lines.zh: 我跟着你踩倒的草走。
lines.en: I follow the grass you have flattened.

lines.zh: 我的须一直冲着你。
lines.en: My antennae stay trained on you.

lines.zh: 你回头的瞬间，我停住了。
lines.en: The moment you look back, I freeze.

lines.zh: 我爬到你背后的树皮上。
lines.en: I climb onto the bark behind you.

lines.zh: 你在跑，我还在慢慢挪。
lines.en: You run, and I keep creeping.

lines.zh: 我不用快，你总要停下来。
lines.en: I need no speed; you must stop sometime.

lines.zh: 我从叶背翻到叶面，看见你了。
lines.en: I roll from leaf underside to top and see you.

lines.zh: 我的身体压弯了草茎。
lines.en: My body bends the stems I cross.

lines.zh: 我在你脚下抬头，已经够近。
lines.en: I look up at you from your feet, close enough.

lines.zh: 我一路滴着甜水跟着你。
lines.en: I trail you, dripping sweet water the whole way.

lines.zh: 我扑到你身上，软软的一团。
lines.en: I throw myself at you, one soft mass.

lines.zh: 我的口器扎进你的皮肤。
lines.en: My mouthparts pierce your skin.

lines.zh: 你甩手，我被甩到树上。
lines.en: You fling your arm and I hit a tree.

lines.zh: 我用体重压你，其实并不重。
lines.en: I press my weight on you, and it is not much.

lines.zh: 我咬住不放，甜水也流出来。
lines.en: I hold on, and sweet water leaks out.

lines.zh: 这一下只让你觉得痒。
lines.en: This attack only makes you itch.

lines.zh: 我的足勾住你的袖子。
lines.en: My feet hook into your sleeve.

lines.zh: 你拍我，我的身体被压得变形。
lines.en: You swat me and my body deforms.

lines.zh: 我又爬回来，慢吞吞的。
lines.en: I crawl back to you, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我不是凶，只是不知道轻重。
lines.en: I am not fierce; I just do not know my strength.

lines.zh: 我从树皮缝里挤出来，身上还是湿的。
lines.en: I squeeze from a bark crevice, still wet.

lines.zh: 森林里这样的出生太多了。
lines.en: Births like this happen all over the forest.

lines.zh: 我一出来就找最近的嫩叶。
lines.en: I look for the nearest tender leaf at once.

lines.zh: 身上还挂着透明的旧壳。
lines.en: A clear old shell still clings to me.

lines.zh: 同一片林子里，我们总有好几只。
lines.en: There are always a few of us in one grove.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，甜水已经渗出来。
lines.en: I shake myself, and sweet water already seeps out.

lines.zh: 树叶在头顶合拢，正合适。
lines.en: The leaves close overhead, which suits me.

lines.zh: 第一口树汁让我安静下来。
lines.en: The first mouthful of sap calms me.

lines.zh: 我很小，但已经比草叶重。
lines.en: I am small, but heavier than a blade of grass.

lines.zh: 我慢慢爬到叶背，那里安全。
lines.en: I crawl slowly to the leaf underside, which is safe.

lines.zh: 火一碰到我，身体就缩成硬块。
lines.en: Fire touches me and my body shrinks to a hard lump.

lines.zh: 从树上掉下来，我的软身摔破了。
lines.en: Falling from the tree, my soft body splits.

lines.zh: 水把我泡胀，甜味散进水里。
lines.en: Water swells me and my sweetness seeps into it.

lines.zh: 气浪把我和叶子一起吹开。
lines.en: The blast blows me and the leaves apart.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在树干上，我还想爬。
lines.en: An arrow pins me to the trunk and I still try to crawl.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的身体亮起奇怪的颜色。
lines.en: Magic makes my body glow in strange colors.

lines.zh: 几天没吸到汁，我的身子瘪了。
lines.en: Days without sap leave my body sunken.

lines.zh: 雷打在树上，我浑身痉挛。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the tree and my whole body spasms.

lines.zh: 虚空的拉扯让我一层层剥落。
lines.en: The void's pull peels me away layer by layer.
